## Assignment 2
##Practicing the first class programs 
```{r }
### Data structure (Vectors, Factors, Lists, Data frame, matrix and arrays)
## Vector
## Numeric 
age<-c(20,25,39,30,32,25)
summary(age)
mean(age)
head(age)

## Logical
y<-c(TRUE,FALSE)
y<-c(T,F)

## Characters
x<-c("a","b","c","d")

## matrix
(x<-matrix(1:4, nrow =2, ncol =2  ))
(y<-matrix(1:6,nrow = 2,ncol = 3))

x%*%y

## List
(x<-list(TRUE,"a",5, 1+5i))

##Factor
x<-factor(c("yes","no","yes","yes"))


```

## Create a vector with NAs in it
```{r }
x<-c(2,3,8,NA,1,25,NA)
is.na(x)
x<-c(1,2,3,4,NA,6,5,NA)
y<-c(NA,20,3,8,NA,9,10,12)
good<-complete.cases(x,y)
good

```
##Creating data
```{r }
## creating a data frame
StudentID<-c(1,2,3,4,5)
Student_Name<-c("Ineza","Nziza","Hirwa","Kundwa","Nkusi")
gender<-c("F","M","M","F","M")
math_score<-c(45,50,44,NA,35)
it_score<-c(28,39,49,50,37)
df<-data.frame(StudentID,Student_Name,gender,math_score,it_score)
df
View(df)
df[1:2]
df[2:5]

## creating data from keyboard

df2<-edit(df2)
```

## Exploration data analysis
```{r }
## Examine numerical variable using common summary

iris
summary(iris)
str(iris)
## summary statistics 
summary(iris)
apply(iris[,1:4],1,sum)
apply(iris [,1:4],2,mean)
apply(iris[,1:4],1,sd)
apply(iris[,1:4],2,sd)
c(mean(iris$Sepal.Length),sd(iris$Sepal.Length))
c(mean(iris$Sepal.Width),sd(iris$Sepal.Width))
c(Mean=mean(iris$Sepal.Length),SD=sd(iris$Sepal.Length))
c(Mean=mean(iris$Sepal.Width),SD=sd(iris$Sepal.Width))
```

### Variation and covariation using both numerical and graphs

```{r }
### Relationship between a categorical and a continuous variable
data("iris")
head(iris)
iris
head(iris)
mean(iris$Petal.Length)
mean(iris$Petal.Length[iris$Petal.Length=="setosa"])
mean(iris$Petal.Length[iris$Species=="setosa"])
mean(iris$Petal.Length[iris$Petal.Length=="versicolor"])
mean(iris$Petal.Length[iris$Species=="versicolor"])
mean(iris$Petal.Length[iris$Species=="virginica"])

## shortcut
by(iris$Petal.Length,iris$Species,mean)
by(iris$Petal.Length,iris$Species,sd)
by(iris$Petal.Length,iris$Species,summary)






```
## Visualize the differences in continuous variables between categories using Box-and-whisker plot
```{r }
boxplot(iris$Petal.Length~Species,data=iris,main="Comparison of categorical vs quantitative")
```
